title: Seedream and Seedance move to Replicate
summary:
Seedream editing gets more flexible, seedance-pro gets dimension-aware video framing, and Gemini 3.5 Flash joins the model lineup.

Seedream 4.0, 4.5 Pro and 5 image generation, plus seedance-pro video generation, were moved to Replicate while keeping their public model IDs. Seedream 5 now supports multiple reference images for edits and can infer an aspect ratio from supplied dimensions. Seedream 4.0 gains custom dimensions, and image requests without a size use the selected model’s defaults. Seedance-pro now accepts seven aspect ratios and infers the closest one from width and height; it is limited to 720p. The older seedance Lite model was retired.

Added paid-only `gemini-3.5-flash` with a 1,048,576-token context window. It accepts text, images, audio and video, and supports tools, search, code execution and reasoning.

Duwit, a business web app by @Ashraf-Swaidan, joined the app catalog and App Greenhouse. The catalog now lists 784 community apps.

highlights.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash added
highlights.text: Use `gemini-3.5-flash` with text, image, audio or video input, plus tools, search, code execution and reasoning. It has a 1,048,576-token context window and requires paid access. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-3.5-flash).

highlights.title: More flexible Seedream edits
highlights.text: Seedream 5 accepts multiple reference images and defaults to the input image’s aspect ratio for edits. It can also infer a non-square aspect ratio when you supply dimensions without one. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedream5).

highlights.title: Custom Seedream 4.0 dimensions
highlights.text: Seedream 4.0 now accepts custom dimensions from 1024 to 4096 pixels for image generation and editing. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Dimension-aware Seedance video
highlights.text: For `seedance-pro`, you can supply width and height without `aspectRatio`; the model selects the closest of seven supported aspect ratios. Output is limited to 720p. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedance-pro).
